minimumVersions.why: from this release an agent definition's model: outranks CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, the unnamed default the shipped settings set; before it that default replaced every model pin
minimumVersions.source: Claude Code CHANGELOG 2.1.251: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to set the default subagent model rather than override everything: an agent definition's `model:` and an explicit per-spawn model now take precedence over it
minimumVersions.limit: sufficiency for the effort: field and for the Agent tool name the guard matches is not established at this version; both were observed working on 2.1.269 and 2.1.270 only

minimumVersions.why: the reviewer-tier Codex profiles pin gpt-6-sol; Codex CLI 0.154.0 rejects that id under ChatGPT-account auth, so below the floor the three reviewer/diagnostic roles cannot dispatch
minimumVersions.source: Codex CLI 0.154.0 on win32, 2026-09-23: `codex exec -m gpt-6-sol` returned 400 invalid_request_error: The 'gpt-6-sol' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account (session 01a0cdca-bd72-7791-95c5-dea62f9fced3). Codex CLI 0.156.1 on the same host and account: completed named subagent rollouts under ~/.codex/sessions/2026/09/23/ for code-reviewer (01a0ce59-9168-7c33-a9a0-11d305c13cd6), security-scanner (01a0ce5c-ac41-71e3-8592-67b36f4174ae), failure-diagnostician (01a0ce5c-c05d-74d0-a404-ff532aa45fc3), and test-writer control (01a0ce5c-e957-78d1-9eae-156011c9649b). Each child's turn_context records the effective model and effort; token usage and task_complete confirm execution
minimumVersions.limit: 0.156.1 is the lowest version observed completing these named dispatches — the exact floor between the rejecting 0.154.0 and the working 0.156.1 was not measured; API-key auth was not tested
